The congruences are

\[
N\equiv 1 \pmod{3},\quad N\equiv 1 \pmod{5},\quad N\equiv 1 \pmod{7},\quad N\equiv 1 \pmod{9}.
\]

Thus

\[
N\equiv 1 \pmod{\operatorname{lcm}(3,5,7,9)}.
\]

Since

\[
\operatorname{lcm}(3,5,7,9)=3^2\cdot 5\cdot 7=315,
\]

we get

\[
N\equiv 1 \pmod{315}.
\]

The smallest integer greater than \(1\) satisfying this is

\[
1+315=316.
\]

\[
\boxed{316}
\]
